source_caption:
They’re together again.🤍

Michelle Trachtenberg and Hayden Panettiere shared the screen in Disney’s Ice Princess back in 2005. Now, more than 20 years later, they’re both gone far too soon.

Hayden, who played Gen Harwood, passed away at just 36. Michelle, who played Casey Carlyle, passed away last year at 39.

Two incredibly talented actresses who became a part of so many childhoods. Two familiar faces from a movie we grew up with, whose memories will live on every time we watch it.

Rest in peace, Hayden and Michelle. You’ll never be forgotten. 🕊️
